name: NEMAR scientific figure system
audience: early graduate researchers and technical collaborators
purpose: Explain NEMAR architecture, dataset lifecycle, DOI versioning, Zarr conversion, edge delivery, and the planned HPC path without turning a scientific resource into decorative marketing art.
non_negotiables: Scientific clarity takes priority over spectacle.
No generated text, pseudo-writing, fake labels, fake numbers, fake logos, or invented endpoint names.
All scientific labels, arrows, legends, URLs, DOI examples, and version strings are added later as exact SVG text.
The real NEMAR logo and the word NEMAR appear as a small lockup in the lower-right corner of every final figure.
The lower-right lockup has clear space, sufficient contrast, and never overlaps scientific content.
Current systems and planned systems are visibly separated; roadmap elements are never presented as shipped features.
Canonical BIDS data is visually distinct from derived Zarr access and from future compute services.

format.final_label_layer: exact SVG text and vector geometry

meaning.ink: canonical source, primary structure, stable contract
meaning.violet: people-facing discovery, reuse, analysis, agent access
meaning.gold: review, citation, versioning, roadmap or planned work

typography.rule: Never ask image generation to render the scientific typography.
typography.labels: sentence case, short, concrete, one idea per line
typography.headline: large but restrained
typography.micro_label: small monospaced uppercase label only when it helps orientation

composition.visual_language: modern technical atlas: layered planes, quiet grid, precise connectors, controlled depth, and generous negative space
composition.flow_direction: left to right for source-to-reuse stories; top to bottom only for a deliberate lifecycle
composition.geometry: rounded panels, connected nodes, stable alignment, no ornamental 3D clutter
layout_constraints: Place dividers at the midpoint of the available gutter; never crowd a panel border.
Align process arrows edge-to-edge on shared horizontal centerlines.
Make summary bars inherit the exact outer span of the elements they summarize.

standalone_title.position: upper-left safe area inside the frame
standalone_title.style: one short descriptive line, readable when the PNG is detached from its page caption
standalone_title.rule: Add the title to the SVG source so the SVG and PNG exports remain identical.

composition.depth: subtle translucency and restrained glow; no neon cyberpunk treatment
composition.background: deep navy technical ground preferred for comparison variants; a light paper variant may be tested

logo_lockup.clear_space: at least 2x the logo mark height from every content element
logo_lockup.treatment: actual NEMAR mark plus wordmark, monochrome or brand-safe two-tone
logo_lockup.scale: small and legible, never a dominant graphic

semantic_shapes.canonical_source: navy or blue plane with solid boundary
semantic_shapes.planned_hpc: gold roadmap lane with explicit planned marker

figure_set.question: How do the website, CLI, API, data plane, Zarr plane, storage, DOI records, people, and agents fit together?
figure_set.visual_story: two client surfaces feed shared contracts, which expose canonical data and derived access layers

figure_set.question: How does a dataset move from preparation to review, DOI release, reuse, and continuous improvement?
figure_set.visual_story: a reviewed release becomes a stable citable state; a later pull request creates a new state

figure_set.question: How can NEMAR support partial in-browser reads now and larger compute near the data later?
figure_set.standalone_title: BIDS to Zarr: edge and browser analysis
figure_set.visual_story: canonical files remain authoritative while derived chunks serve lightweight analysis and a planned HPC lane handles larger jobs

forbidden: fake UI or fake dashboard text
image_generation_policy.finalization: Choose a substrate only after comparison, then overlay exact SVG geometry, text, arrows, figure number, caption, and NEMAR lockup. If no substrate improves the exact vector schematic, ship the vector schematic without a raster substrate.

comparison_rubric.ship_rule: A candidate is not selected if it requires generated text to communicate the science, crowds the label layer, or makes a planned feature look current.
